description: Every game and the host run on iOS 15.0+ and WebView 80+: one local deep-copy helper replaces structuredClone, index math replaces Array.prototype.at and findLastIndex, and the committed scan of tests/apk3d/no-unpolyfilled-builtins.test.ts widens to src/ and fails on any ES2022+ built-in that the demo build does not polyfill
deviation_notes: Created 2026-11-22 from the ES2022+ built-in scan of src/ on 2026-11-22: 44 hits at baseline a414b406 (35 structuredClone, 8 array .at(, 1 findLastIndex). The device gate stays as it is (PM decision 2026-11-22): old Android phones with WebView 80 to 97 are the audience. Due 2026-11-27, before the Storytime launch of 2026-11-30. Amended 2026-11-23 after spec review r1 (report spec-review-af00767): the 8 array .at( sites are listed by line, the track widens the committed scanner tests/apk3d/no-unpolyfilled-builtins.test.ts instead of adding a second one, audio task T6k 0cc7b5c4 is recorded as a met prerequisite for the Object.hasOwn deletion, and the stale 217-file/3,299-test pin left AC4.
